notes: Account: SaaS support platform used by ~300 customers. Primary product: customer-facing KB + chat widget.
Primary ask: hosted RAG that supports moderate index scale (200k-500k docs) but very high QPS on read traffic (400-800 QPS peak).
Latency targets: first-pass (ANN) <120ms median, full response (retrieval + rerank + generation) <350ms ideally. CTO said: "end-to-end must feel instant for customers".
Cost sensitivity: underway — finance wants cost per successful query < $0.002 at scale; exploring Optimize recommendations to hit target.

Model preferences: prefer open models where possible (Llama2-13B/14B, Mistral) for embeddings and rerank variants — willing to consider Redwood-verified smaller encoder models for first-pass to save cost.
Pipeline preference: sparse BM25 for recall + vector ANN for semantic filtering + light cross-encoder rerank for top-10 candidates. Need guidance on embedding quantization and sharding strategy.
Caching ask: aggressive prefix/KV caching for popular KB articles, TTL policy per-route. They expect heavy tail traffic to a small subset of articles.
Data: docs include screenshots, transcripts, markdown; average doc size 1.2k tokens; total PII low but product logs may include emails. Retention controls required.
Security: SSO (Okta) already in place; key management via AWS KMS preferred; require audit logs for all inference requests for compliance audits.
Quote from CTO (Alex Rivera): "If we can keep median end-to-end under 250ms and show stable $/query, we can move to reserved capacity next quarter."
They asked for a simple failure/fallback story: fallback to a smaller model and cached snippets if reranker unavailable.
Requested artifacts: benchmark file from our hosted API (synthetic QPS 500), optimization playbook, and a sample SLA for mid-market customers.
technical_summary: Evaluation of hosted API for KB RAG. Current POC indexing ~300k docs, embedding dim 1536, ANN first-pass + cross-encoder rerank. Targets: 400-800 QPS, median retrieval <120ms, rerank <250ms, end-to-end <350ms. Cost sensitivity high; want Optimize suggestions (batching, quantization, route policies).
arch_constraints: Primarily public cloud; no on-prem or air-gapped for now. EU residency for subset of customers planned (Q3).
recent_test_results: 99th percentile tail spikes to 900ms under unoptimized batching
